page.overview:
Who is Elias Brandyworth?

Dr. Elias Brandyworth was a government scientist, assistant director of the Pentagon's department of superhuman research and Atom Eve's creator.

In his initial appearance, Elias Brandyworth has White/gray hair which is fairly long and well combed. He wears a pink shirt, brown pants and blue sport shoes along with a long white lab coat while working as a scientist for the government. After going rogue, Brandyworth has essentially become homeless, spotting a dirty brown coat over his lab attire, his hair has grown longer and more shaggy, he has also grown a full beard and wrinkles, making him look tired and much older than he should look.

Elias Brandyworth was an intelligent man who was extremely dedicated to his work and passionate about breaking new grounds in genetic engineering. After meeting Polly, he forms a deep friendship with her, keeping a close watch on her at all times during her pregnancy. During this time, Brandyworth had a change of heart and realized the error in his line of work and went out of his way to save Polly and her unborn child from being turned into Government experiments.

After Polly's death and him being fired by the Pentagon, Brandyworth becomes homeless, spending his days closely monitoring on Eve from the shadows and trying to reconnect with her. He became extremely protective of Eve. Instructing her to not use her powers to not cause any attention her way, but after realising that Eve was now a hero in the making, Brandyworth instead chose to give her closure about her past and how much he wished for her to have a normal life.
